name: One-object LFS upload probe
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - cloud/lfs-upload-probe-20261023-0751
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/lfs-upload-probe.yml
permissions: {}
jobs:
  probe:
    if: github.repository == 'qianyizhang/med-assets' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/cloud/lfs-upload-probe-20261023-0751'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: write
    env:
      EXPECTED_OID: b68787a1a90912ebd75fd8c60492c34072c61dce86384775e9609d94e80e676e
      EXPECTED_SIZE: '74136'
      PUBLIC_SOURCE: https://heart-anatomy-imaging-lab.landy123007.chatgpt.site/body/3d/assets/motion/diaphragm_breathing.glb
      GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT: '0'
    steps:
      - name: Configure ordinary repository authentication
        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # Verified official v6 tag on 2026-10-23
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          lfs: false
          submodules: false
          sparse-checkout: .gitattributes
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          persist-credentials: true
          show-progress: false
      - name: Fetch only the approved public bytes and verify
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib, os, pathlib, urllib.request
          expected = os.environ['EXPECTED_OID']
          size = int(os.environ['EXPECTED_SIZE'])
          request = urllib.request.Request(os.environ['PUBLIC_SOURCE'], headers={'User-Agent': 'med-assets-lfs-probe/1.0'})
          with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=30) as response:
              data = response.read(size + 1)
          assert len(data) == size, 'Source size mismatch'
          assert data[:4] == b'glTF', 'Source is not GLB bytes'
          assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == expected, 'Source SHA-256 mismatch'
          pathlib.Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP'], 'approved-diaphragm.glb').write_bytes(data)
          print(f'Approved public source verified: {size} bytes, SHA-256 {expected}')
          PY
      - name: Upload this one OID through normal Git LFS
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git lfs version
          git lfs install --local
          git lfs clean approved-diaphragm.glb < "$RUNNER_TEMP/approved-diaphragm.glb" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/approved-diaphragm.pointer"
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import os, pathlib
          expected = 'version https://git-lfs.github.com/spec/v1\noid sha256:' + os.environ['EXPECTED_OID'] + '\nsize ' + os.environ['EXPECTED_SIZE'] + '\n'
          actual = pathlib.Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP'], 'approved-diaphragm.pointer').read_text()
          assert actual == expected, 'Generated LFS pointer mismatch'
          PY
          git lfs push --object-id origin "$EXPECTED_OID"
      - name: Independently download from GitHub without local LFS cache or user credentials
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib, json, os, urllib.parse, urllib.request
          oid = os.environ['EXPECTED_OID']
          size = int(os.environ['EXPECTED_SIZE'])
          endpoint = 'https://github.com/qianyizhang/med-assets.git/info/lfs/objects/batch'
          payload = json.dumps({'operation': 'download', 'transfers': ['basic'], 'objects': [{'oid': oid, 'size': size}]}).encode()
          headers = {'Accept': 'application/vnd.git-lfs+json', 'Content-Type': 'application/vnd.git-lfs+json', 'User-Agent': 'med-assets-lfs-probe/1.0'}
          with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(endpoint, data=payload, headers=headers), timeout=30) as response:
              result = json.load(response)
          objects = result.get('objects', [])
          assert len(objects) == 1, 'Unexpected LFS Batch response'
          obj = objects[0]
          assert obj.get('oid') == oid and obj.get('size') == size, 'LFS Batch object identity mismatch'
          assert 'error' not in obj, 'GitHub does not serve the uploaded object'
          action = obj.get('actions', {}).get('download')
          assert action, 'No GitHub LFS download action'
          assert urllib.parse.urlsplit(action['href']).scheme == 'https', 'Non-HTTPS LFS transport refused'
          request = urllib.request.Request(action['href'], headers=action.get('header', {}))
          with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=30) as response:
              data = response.read(size + 1)
          assert len(data) == size, 'Downloaded LFS size mismatch'
          assert data[:4] == b'glTF', 'Downloaded LFS content is not GLB'
          assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == oid, 'Downloaded LFS SHA-256 mismatch'
          print(f'PASS: independent GitHub LFS response is {size} bytes, SHA-256 {oid}')
          print('No Git asset pointer or branch-tip commit was pushed by this job.')
          PY
